name: Antonette (Toni) Perry

bio.statement: Perry's pamphlet statement lists work as a City of Portland emergency communications operator, small business owner and Oregon Judicial Department management assistant.
bio.excerpt: Emergency Communications Operator, City of Portland; Small business owner; Management Assistant, Oregon Judicial Department

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Perry says local government should be independent and nonpartisan.
positions.excerpt: I believe local government should be independent and nonpartisan.

positions.statement: Perry's pamphlet statement says Gladstone does not need to become a destination for big-city tourism.
positions.excerpt: I do not believe we need to turn Gladstone into a destination for big-city tourism

positions.statement: Perry's pamphlet statement says Gladstone residents value the character of their small community.
positions.excerpt: I believe Gladstone residents value the character of our small community.
